title: Mapping study on digital and technical solutions to enable more effective and user-friendly UVARs, while respecting the principle of subsidiarity
description:
Please note that this is not a call for tenders but a publication announcing the Contracting authority’s intention to publish a future negotiated low or middle valueprocedure. 
The justification for the study arises from the provisions of the Smart Mobility Strategy (SSMS) COM (2020) 789 and in specific the 2021 New Urban Mobility Framework (UMF) COM (2021) 811. The SMSS calls for EU and Member States to deliver on citizens’ expectations of cleaner air, less noise and congestion through an improved European framework on urban mobility. Urban Vehicle Access Regulations (UVARs) are essential in this context as a means to address issues of local air quality, congestion and noise caused by urban transport. The UMF calls for an uptake on resolving specific UVAR challenges that risk to adversely affect the internal market as concerns the free movement of persons and goods along the TEN-T network and its urban nodes. The study is explicitly referred to under the action box of UMF chapter 2.7. 
Across Europe, there is a variety of UVAR schemes applied and there is no “one size-fits all approach” for such schemes in view of the specific city challenges the scheme is to respond to. The variety of different schemes, its governance, compliance and enforcement modus-operandi thus poses new challenges for passenger and freight transport which in turn affects and limits the effectiveness of measures taken and leads to complaints by road users. In recent years, the Commission has received an increasing number of complaints from European citizens. Especially during UVAR start-up phases, there is a risk that the haphazard implementation of UVARs jeopardizes public acceptance, creates obstacles to free movement of persons and goods under internal market perspectives and to fair and equal treatment of resident and non-residents (discrimination). Increasing UVAR efficiency under user-friendly compliance and information schemes is thus essential, as is the cross-border data exchange of vehicle and driver data, UVAR digitisation etc.
The study mainly builds on the conclusions and recommendation of the UVAR Exchange Project to be completed in Feb 2023 – and others of relevance such as e.g. the UVAR BOX and Civitas-ReVeAL intervention that ended in theth quarter 2022. The purpose is to map and clarify on digital and technical solutions in order to enable more effective and user-friendly UVARs.

title: Finland – Photographs – Satellite Orthoimages in Finland 2027
description: GENERAL Please note that this is a prior information notice (hereafter “notice”) and not a call for tenders. The information provided in this notice is preliminary and may change during the preparation phase. Hansel Oy acts in a consultative role in this procurement. DESCRIPTION OF THE PROCUREMENT National Land Survey of Finland ("NLS") is planning to purchase satellite orthoimages covering areas in Finland. The production areas to be ordered are based on the national aerial imaging programme, under which Finland will be aerially imaged over a period of three years, excluding the northernmost parts of Lapland. The upcoming procurement forms part of the NLS' preparedness for the situation where aerial images cannot be obtained from all production areas due to GNSS interference. The acquisition time for the satellite orthoimages is approximately from April to August. The satellite orthoimages must be snow free with minimum cloud coverage. The maximum resolution of the orthoimage is 0.5 m. Satellite orthoimages must be mosaicked seamlessly and delivered as 6*6 km grids that are fully covered, with minimum four bands (Red (R), Green (G), Blue (B) and Near InfraRed (Nir). The orthoimages must be delivered fully processed including radiometric correction, georectification, orthorectification and atmospheric compensation (i.e., GIS ready images) following the requirements listed in the final call for tenders. The upcoming procurement is planned to cover the possible needs for satellite orthoimages for year 2027. REGISTRATION Companies interested in this upcoming procurement are requested to submit their contact details by email to kilpailutus@hansel.fi. Please use the subject line: “NLS: Satellite Orthomosaics in Finland”. MARKET DIALOGUE Companies that register by 30th October 2026 will be given the opportunity to comment on the draft materials during the commenting period (approximately 2nd November - 6th November). Registered companies will be able to provide written comments on the draft materials. NLS reserves the possibility for additional commenting rounds and/or meetings or phone calls if deemed necessary for the preparation of the procurement. Participation or non‑participation in the market dialogue does not affect eligibility to participate in the tender procedure.

Durchführung von Messungen, Prüfungen und Zertifizierungsmessungen gemäß vereinbarter Prüfkriterien. Erstellung vollständiger, elektronisch weiter verarbeitbarer Dokumentation einschließlich Port-, Faser-, Kabellisten nach Vorgabe des AG. Online abrufbare Bereitstellung von Messprotokollen einzubauender LWL-Verkabelung Unterstützung der Abnahme und Mängelbeseitigung bis zur betriebsbereiten Übergabe. Sicherstellung redundanter A-/B-Verbindungswege zur Unterstützung hochverfügbarer Betriebsmodelle. Minimierung betrieblicher Risiken durch standardisierte Komponenten, Qualitätssicherung und nachvollziehbare Abnahmeprozesse. Schaffung von Reservekapazitäten für Wachstum, Technologiezyklen und spätere Erweiterungen im laufenden Betrieb. Der AN hat sicherzustellen, dass die angebotenen und verbauten Komponenten der passiven Verkabelungsinfrastruktur für einen Zeitraum von mindestens fünf Jahren ab Abnahme der Leistung verfügbar bleiben. Sofern einzelne Komponenten innerhalb des genannten Zeitraums durch den Hersteller abgekündigt, ersetzt oder technisch weiterentwickelt werden, hat der AN rechtzeitig gleichwertige und vollständig kompatible Nachfolgekomponenten anzubieten und deren Kompatibilität zum bestehenden Gesamtsystem nachzuweisen. Änderungen dürfen die bestehende Systemgarantie, Dokumentationslogik, Beschriftungssystematik, Port- und Kassettenzuordnung sowie die Betriebs- und Wartungsfähigkeit der installierten Infrastruktur nicht beeinträchtigen. Der AN hat mit Angebotsabgabe eine entsprechende Hersteller- oder Lieferantenerklärung vorzulegen, aus der die Verfügbarkeit, Nachlieferbarkeit oder Kompatibilität der angebotenen Systemkomponenten für mindestens fünf Jahre hervorgeht.

description: En el marc del Projecte PhotSat, l’Institut d’Estudis Espacials de Catalunya (IEEC) té la previsió de licitar la contractació del subministrament d’un filtre en forma de recobriment per a detectors. Aquest filtre serà utilitzat en l’espai i recobrirà els detectors del nanosatèl·lit del projecte. L’objecte de la present consulta preliminar de mercat és recollir informació tècnica que permeti preparar correctament la licitació per implementar un filtre en forma de recobriment per als detectors del nanosatèl·lit de Photsat. D’altra banda, atenent a la dificultat tècnica que presenta la configuració de la licitació, també és objecte de la present consulta conèixer els preus de mercat actuals per tal de determinar el pressupost de licitació, en funció de les prestacions que pugui desenvolupar la futura empresa contractista. En la seva participació en la consulta, els operadors que hi participin podran anar una mica més enllà de les capacitats actuals que ofereix a dia d’avui el mercat, quedant a valoració de l’IEEC si aquestes innovacions poden ser d’interès per al projecte. L’IEEC està interessat en totes les respostes, de manera que qualsevol aportació que pugui aportar elements d’interès per al projecte es considerarà rellevant per a la configuració del procés de contractació posterior. La determinació dels elements tècnics i econòmics del futur procés de contractació depèn en gran manera de la qualitat i del resultat de la present consulta, de manera que es demana als operadors participants la màxima precisió possible.

title: HYDRON UPGRADE KIT: ESTOL-COMPLIANT PORTABLE MODEM UPGRADE KIT FOR OPTICAL GROUND STATIONS (ARTES 4.0 SL SPL 6C.091) EXPRO+
description: Objective:To develop a portable modem that can be easily integrated in an existing optical ground station to make it compatible with ESTOL specificationsTargeted Improvements:Increased interoperability between existing optical ground stations and future satellite systems (e.g., HydRON).Description:There are a number of existing or planned optical ground stations (OGSs) that are currently used for scientific missions or to demonstrate quantum technologies. Those OGSs are not compliant to the ESA Specifications for Terabit/s Optical Links (ESTOL). To maximise the benefit of early Member State investments, the activity shall develop an upgrade kit" for multiple existing OGS infrastructures. An easy-to-integrate modem will facilitate the upgrade of such existing or planned OGSsand increase their interoperability with future commercial and institutional systems that will adopt ESTOL and its evolutions.Thisactivity shall develop a portable breadboard for an ESTOL-compliant modem. In the scope of the activity, it shall be assumed that thetarget existing OGSs have already been developed in terms of optical elements (e.g., aperture, adaptive optics, etc.) in order tobecompatible with ESTOL. The portable modem shall be connected to the optical part of the OGS by optical fibre, and it shall implement both transmit and receive functionalities. The modem breadboard shall come with a GUI and an interface control document to facilitate its fast and easy integration and use. The functionalities of the portable modem shall be validated in the Contractor's laboratory and in an existing selected OGS.Procurement Policy: C(1) = Activity restricted to non-prime contractors (incl. title: Service contract for further development of EU water balances at sub-catchment level - preparatory action - development of prevention activities to halt desertification in Europe.
description: The objective of this call for tender is to produce revised and complete European water resource balances (quantity, quality) with monthly resolution at sub-basin level. The project should address and mitigate the most relevant data gaps (as well as methodological gaps induced by the absence of data) so that water balances can be established at sub-catchment level for the whole EU with at least the level of confidence achieved in the group of best documented basins to allow better comparability across Europe, at the end of the contract. It should as well validate those components of the water balance that could not be finalised because of these data gaps. The present project should also contribute to the design and prototyping of a permanent and cost-effective process for the production of water balances, improving the interaction between reconstructed and reported data.http://ec.europa.eu/environment/water/index_en.htm

title: Teleskooppikuormaaja ja siihen kytkettävät lisälaitteet
description: Luonnonvarakeskus (Luke) hankkii Jokioisille tutkimusmaatilan käyttöön teleskooppikuormaajan (Kurottaja). Kuormaajaa käytetään uudessa tutkimusnavetassa ja tilalla olkipetipohjien, vasikkalan ja ulkotarhojen tyhjennyksessä, biokaasulaitoksen biopohjaisten syötemateriaalien käsittelyssä, pyörö- ja kanttipaalien käsittelyssä, trukkilavojen siirrossa, erilaisten pintojen siivoamisessa, suursäkkien siirrossa, laakasiilojen muovituksessa ja peittämisessä säilörehun korjuuaikoina ja erilaisissa korjaus- ja huoltotöissä, joissa voi hyödyntää kuormaajan ulottuvuutta ja ketteryyttä. Jokioisten tutkimusmaatilalla uutta hankittavaa teleskooppikuormaajaa käytetään useissa työtehtävissä, joten kuormaajaan hankitaan myös siihen kytkettäviä lisälaitteita hankintaan varatun määrärahan puitteissa. Hankinta on jaettu kahteen osa-alueeseen: 1. Teleskooppikuormaaja 2. Teleskooppikuormaajaan kytkettävät lisälaitteet Tarjoaja voi jättää tarjouksen yhteen tai molempiin osa-alueisiin. Osa-alueet vertaillaan ja pisteytetään erikseen ja kummassakin osa-alueessa toimittajaksi valitaan halvimman kokonaishinnan tarjonnut toimittaja. Kuormaajaa käytetään uudessa tutkimusnavetassa ja tilalla olkipetipohjien, vasikkalan ja ulkotarhojen tyhjennyksessä, biokaasulaitoksen biopohjaisten syötemateriaalien käsittelyssä, pyörö- ja kanttipaalien käsittelyssä, trukkilavojen siirrossa, erilaisten pintojen siivoamisessa, suursäkkien siirrossa, laakasiilojen muovituksessa ja peittämisessä säilörehun korjuuaikoina ja erilaisissa korjaus- ja huoltotöissä, joissa voi hyödyntää kuormaajan ulottuvuutta ja ketteryyttä. Kuormaajalle asetetut vaatimukset on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön kohdassa "Hankinnan kohteen kriteerit". Jokioisten tutkimusmaatilalla uutta hankittavaa teleskooppikuormaajaa käytetään useissa työtehtävissä, joten kuormaajaan tarvitaan laaja kirjo siihen kytkettäviä lisälaitteita. Lisälaitteiden tulee olla kytkettävissä normin ISO23206 (EURO) HV mukaisesti. Lisälaitteina kuormaajaan hankitaan varatun määrärahan puitteissa etusijajärjestyksessä alla olevasta listasta tärkeimmistä (1, 2, 3 etc.) alkaen: 1. Kauha kahmarilla iso, leveys 1800 mm 2.
